query:
SELECT c.id AS "id!"
        FROM unnest($1::uuid[]) AS links(link_id)
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT t.id
            FROM email_threads t
            WHERE t.link_id = links.link_id
              AND t.has_calendar_attachment
            ORDER BY COALESCE(t.latest_non_spam_message_ts, t.updated_at) DESC, t.id DESC
            LIMIT $2
        ) c
        LIMIT $2
